decisions.decision: Archetype is product. npm package coldeye plus FilePress marketing site at coldeye.dev. Same shelf as Detangler and aiBreze.
decisions.rationale: User staked the npm name, registered the domain, and named GitHub Catalyst-Forge-LLC/coldeye. Same distribution shape as Detangler: installable package, skill folder, public site.

decisions.decision: The skill is the product. One folder: skills/cold-eye. No command-line pass. No apply skill.
decisions.rationale: The critique is agent behavior. User asked to keep Cold-eye clean and emulate Detangler's skill-only shape, without a second hour.
alternatives_considered: two critique modes in one package

decisions.decision: No PocketBase, no auth, no accounts. Local files plus a static FilePress site.
decisions.rationale: State is the subject and the critique on disk. Nothing needs to outlive the browser or sync across devices.

decisions.decision: Implementation language is TypeScript ESM on Node 20+, pnpm, matching Detangler and house rules. Catalog only — no bin.
decisions.rationale: House rule: TypeScript ESM for all Node application and script code. Sibling package is already this stack.

decisions.decision: Unfinished-plan / attack-planning is out of this product. Refuse it. Do not name or ship a second hour for it.
decisions.rationale: User already has that hour in the sibling temperpass repo. Keep Cold-eye a finished-artifact pass only.
alternatives_considered: Keep a red-team refuse-and-route in the skill
Ship two skills in one package

decisions.decision: Phase 2 exit criteria rewritten for a skill package + static site instead of web-app CRUD.
decisions.rationale: Default tracking template assumes a PocketBase web app. Cold-eye is a local package.
alternatives_considered: Leave CRUD wording and mark N/A later

decisions.decision: Pruned Phase 7 auth-flow, payment-flow, LLM field-limit, API-error-format, Zod, and as-any exit criteria. Revisit if a paid tier or runtime API appears.
decisions.rationale: v1 is a free npm package and static site. No accounts, no checkout, no project-owned model API.
alternatives_considered: Keep payment criteria as a reminder

decisions.decision: No live web search. No project-owned LLM API. The hosting agent is the judgment.
decisions.rationale: Same as Detangler. Draft/card text is data. Fence it. Do not send it to a project-owned cloud API.

decisions.decision: The subject is anything shipped, deemed done, or ready to ship. One file or a system. Skills, specs, sites, packages, and repos are examples, not a closed set.
decisions.rationale: User: expand the targets; the gate is the claim of done or ready, not a file-type list.
alternatives_considered: Keep subjects to skill, spec, procedure, repo only

decisions.decision: LocalBerth lease is coldeye-site on 5200. site:dev reads the lease and passes --port to FilePress.
decisions.rationale: 5199 is detangler-site. Claiming a port without binding FilePress to it is not a lease.
alternatives_considered: Let FilePress pick a random port

gotchas.issue: localberth claim fails on this Windows shell when --notes has a space (shell:true splits it) or when --notes=value is combined with --or-next.
gotchas.resolution: ensure-lease.mjs claims with --port and --or-next, then retries without --or-next. Never pass --notes with a space (Windows shell:true splits it). If the port is already listening, localberth still records the lease.

gotchas.issue: site/static/<slug>/index.html does not serve at /<slug> in filepress dev. SvelteKit 404s the page route first and 308s /<slug>/ back to /<slug>.
gotchas.resolution: Mount each stub as a FilePress paths entry (url /install ← static/install, same for skill and critique). Production still uses _redirects.
